# Changelog

**This file is generated. Do not hand-edit it.**

```bash
npx projen changelog        # auto-changelog, over the conventional-commit history
```

Everything below the line is overwritten by that command, so an edit made here is lost the next time
anyone runs it. To change what a release note says, the commit message is the thing to fix — see
[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) → Changelog for why the `feat:` / `fix:` / `chore:` / `docs:` /
`test:` prefixes are the only input this file has.

Releases are cut from tags. There are no semver tags yet, so a run today groups everything under
*Unreleased*; that is expected, not a misconfiguration.

---
